Macabee Pizza Bagels (Frozen)

Ingredients:
1 frozen Macabee pizza bagel

Instructions:
Keep frozen until ready to use. Cook thoroughly.
Oven (preferred): preheat to 450°F. Place frozen pizza bagels on a baking sheet and bake 11-13 minutes (time is for 4 bagels). Let stand 1 minute before eating.
Toaster oven: preheat to 400°F. Bake 15 minutes (for 4 bagels). Let stand 1 minute.
Microwave (1100 watts): 1 bagel, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes; 4 bagels, 2 1/2 to 3 minutes. Let stand 1 minute.
note: Store-bought frozen staple, 1 serving = 1 pizza bagel. Package facts verified: serving size 1 piece (64 g), 6 pieces in the 13.5 oz package; directions above are the printed package directions (label transcription via Directions For Me; ShopRite's listing for the same UPC agrees). Kosher: dairy. Category: Main. Tags: frozen, store-bought, lunch, staple.
